feed.title: Verilay Patchmap: Remote Desktop
feed.subtitle: Known problems and monthly security updates for Windows, from Verilay Patchmap. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

entry.title: Now fixed: Remote Desktop connections might fail for non-admin users with error 0xC000000D
entry.summary: Started with KB5124010. Fixed in KB5132061. Affects: Windows 11 24H2, Windows 11 25H2, Windows 11 26H2. Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/release-health/status-windows-11-24h2#5031msgdesc. From Microsoft release health.
